mutations.rationale: Collapsing soft and hard break presentation would make a soft break indistinguishable from a hard break, breaking the distinct break semantics.
mutations.find:
case .softBreak:
            appendSynthetic(" ", kind: .softLineBreak, after: node, refuseEdits: false)
mutations.replace:
case .softBreak:
            appendSynthetic("\n", kind: .softLineBreak, after: node, refuseEdits: false)
